aboutPage.h2:
Modern complex
in the heart of Rivne
aboutPage.text1: «Central Hotels & Restaurants» is a complex of hotels and restaurants of the «Papa&Mama» network, located in the central part of the city. The «Central» and «Mono» hotels together offer 62 comfortable rooms with a modern interior, from single to double rooms, some of which overlook the main square. The complex also has an electric charging station for guests traveling by electric vehicles.
aboutPage.text2: The «Papa&Mama» network also offers recreation in the hotel and restaurant complex «4x4», located on the Rivne bypass road. Here guests can enjoy a comfortable stay at the «4x4» hotel, as well as delicious cuisine in the «Porshen» and «4x4» restaurants.

conditionsPage.h2:
Rules and conditions of stay
in our hotel network
conditionsPage.title: Accommodation conditions at “Central” and “Mono” hotels
hotelRules: The room is provided upon presentation of a passport or other identity document (Ukrainian passport, international passport, foreign national passport or equivalent document, birth certificate for minors under 14 years, driver’s license, military ID) and filling out the registration form.
The room price includes a full breakfast, which can be chosen upon check-in, and parking.
Tourist tax is not included in the room price.

extraFee.title: Extra fees
list: Early check-in before 10:00 AM – 100% of the room rate.
Late check-out after 4:00 PM – 100% of the room rate.
Early check-in and late check-out are possible subject to room availability.
The hotel provides the option to rent a baby crib or a foldable bed.

payment.title: Payment
list: Payment is made upon or before check-in.
All prices are in UAH. We accept cash, bank transfer, or credit/debit cards.
In case of no-show for a pre-booked and paid room, money is not refunded. Refunds are possible up to 3 days before arrival.

compensation.title: Hotel property compensation
list: Smoking is prohibited in rooms, corridors, lobby, breakfast area, and elevator. There is a designated smoking area at the entrance.
In case of loss or damage of the key, the guest must pay according to the price list.
The guest is responsible for damage to hotel property and for actions of their invited persons. The amount of damage is determined by hotel management.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Free parking is available for hotel guests, equipped with CCTV. The hotel is not responsible for left vehicles!

forgottenItems.title: Forgotten items
forgottenItems.text: If the cleaning staff finds personal items after checking the room, we notify the guests and store them for 6 months or send via courier. The hotel is not responsible for personal belongings.

fortissimoRestaurantPage.title: Food & Drinks
fortissimoRestaurantPage.description: A modern street bar in the center of Rivne, created for those who appreciate a combination of stylish interior, vibrant flavors, and lively atmosphere.
fortissimoRestaurantPage.dishesTitle: A place where meetings, emotions, and moments become memories
fortissimoRestaurantPage.interiorDescription: Fortissimo is known for its atmosphere, attentive service, and special energy that makes every visit unforgettable.
fortissimoRestaurantPage.streetBarDesc1: Fortissimo is a modern street bar in the heart of Rivne, combining stylish industrial design with a warm and cozy atmosphere. Inside, guests are greeted by the harmony of brick walls and dark metal elements, creating a unique mood for friendly gatherings or evening relaxation.
fortissimoRestaurantPage.streetBarDesc2: The restaurant's menu offers original dishes that combine signature recipes with popular street hits, while the cocktail menu will pleasantly surprise even experienced gourmets.

monoRestaurantPage.title: luogo unico
monoRestaurantPage.description: In our unique restaurant, modern design blends with the cozy and warm atmosphere of Italy.
monoRestaurantPage.dishesTitle: The most delicious traditions of Italian cuisine in one menu
monoRestaurantPage.interiorDescription: The stylish interior combines modern comfort with a cozy atmosphere, creating the perfect conditions for relaxation.
monoRestaurantPage.streetBarDesc1: Our Italian restaurant was born out of a love for traditional cuisine and memories of family dinners in a small coastal town. The idea came during travels across Italy, where each region revealed new flavors and culinary stories.
monoRestaurantPage.streetBarDesc2: The inspiration came not only from food but also from the philosophy of Italian life — enjoying the moment, simplicity, and authenticity. Each dish on the menu is a classic recipe with the chef's personal touch, so guests can feel Italy in every detail.
